sources.title: Teraco: Cape Town Data Centres CT1 and CT2 (locations page, version modified 28 September 2026; captured 27 October 2026)
sources.summary: Teraco's Cape Town locations page says Teraco operates vendor-neutral colocation data centres in Johannesburg, Cape Town and Durban and lists its Cape Town facilities as Rondebosch CT1 and Brackenfell CT2. CT1, located in the commercial heart of Rondebosch, is described as Teraco's first vendor-neutral colocation facility, which set the benchmark for service delivery and the 99.999% uptime design methodology used in all its subsequent facilities; its key attributes are 2,500 sqm white space and an IT load of 5, with an interconnected ecosystem of more than 7,000 cross-connects, 100+ network service providers, 25+ content providers, 100+ IT services providers, 25+ enterprises and financial service providers and on-ramps to major global cloud services. It gives the address Great Westerford Building, Rondebosch, Cape Town and 'GPS Co-ordinates: -33.971200, 18.464900'.
